subject: Pilot acceptance criteria & instrumentation plan
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Shaw <daniel@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot acceptance criteria & instrumentation plan

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Below is a concise recap, proposed acceptance criteria for the two-week pilot, and clear next steps + owners so everyone is aligned going into kickoff. Let me know if I missed anything.

Quick recap:
- Use case: BrightCart wants to validate Redwood inference for personalized search re-ranking and chat assistance during peak traffic (holiday promo simulation).
- Scope for pilot: a two-week pilot against a staging slice (approx. 500K user events) covering search rerank API, a streaming chat endpoint for contextual assistant, and one tool-calling prototype to fetch product inventory.

Proposed acceptance criteria (must-haves to mark pilot success):
1) Latency: 95th p99 <= 220 ms for synchronous rerank (500-token windows); streaming chat tail latency for first byte <= 150 ms under 50 rps sustained.
2) Quality: NDCG@10 improvement >= 8% vs current baseline on the curated eval set we shared. Chat answers must have <5% hallucination rate on the 40-check prompt set (we'll co-author the prompts).
3) Reliability: No more than 1% error rate across calls during peak test window and graceful fallback to smaller model with <1s extra latency.
4) Integration: SDK-based streaming implementation and example tool-calling flow that BrightCart engineers can run locally within 2 hours using our sample repo.
5) Observability: Per-request token / cost attribution and traces available in Redwood Console for every test run.

Evaluation plan and owners:
- Data & staging access (BrightCart): provide S3 staging bucket access by Tue 2027-05-04 — owner: Daniel Shaw.
- Test harness & metrics (Redwood): we will run the load profile and provide dashboards; owner: Karthik Iyer (SE).
- Quality eval: shared eval script + prompts; joint run and results before EOD 2027-05-14 — owners: Laura & Daniel.

Technical integration checklist (high level)
- SDK: add redwood-js or redwood-py client and run example streaming chat snippet.
- API routes: rerank via /v1/rerank, chat streaming via /v1/chat/stream (we'll provide exact routes and headers).
- Tool calling: attach a single inventory tool with schema and implement function metadata; Redwood will return structured tool-call responses.
- Security: minimal IP allowlist for staging, and an initial SOC2 questionnaire (we'll route procurement separately).

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.pdf (outline & milestones), brightcart_pilot_map.xlsx (sample dataset counts), redwood_sdk_streaming_snippets.md (sample code).

Next steps (short timeline):
- Mon 2027-05-03: legal/procurement intro if needed (Procurement on this thread).
- Tue 2027-05-04: staging S3 access confirmed (Daniel).
- Wed 2027-05-05: Redwood SE deploys test harness and verifies routes (Karthik).
- Fri 2027-05-07: lightweight kickoff + tech walkthrough (30m).

If that works, I'll calendar the 30m kickoff for Fri morning and share the HubSpot mutual action item tracker.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Laura — thanks for the clear write-up. We agree with the scope and the proposed success criteria in principle. A few clarifications from our side before we confirm access: 

- For the NDCG baseline and the 40-check prompt set, can you provide the exact format you expect (CSV vs JSONL) and an example eval run? We want to make sure our offline eval maps perfectly.
- Streaming: we need a short sample that shows reconnect handling (we have flaky corporate NATs). Can you include a snippet that shows a websocket+resume approach or token-based resume?
- Tool calling: when you say "function metadata", can you show a minimal schema for the inventory lookup so our backend can stub quickly?
- Procurement will likely want a sandbox SLA for the pilot window and confirmation that data is isolated and retained for 7 days only. 

We can provide S3 staging by EOD Tue 2027-05-04 once we sign the minimal MSA addendum — procurement looped. I'll confirm who will own the S3 IAM role by Monday.

Also attaching a one-pager on the internal evaluation committee's timeline (attached: brightcart_pilot_map.xlsx).

Regards,
Daniel

Hi Daniel — quick technical follow-up and I pasted a few minimal examples below to unblock your engineers. We'll also drop these into the shared Drive folder and the code attachment.

1) Eval format
- We accept JSONL where each line is: {"query": "...", "candidates": [ ... ], "gold_rank": [ ... ] } — we will provide a small sample JSONL with 200 queries so you can sanity-check locally.

2) Streaming snippet (node) — reconnect pattern (high level):
- Use the redwood-js streaming client that exposes a reconnect token in the last-frame metadata. On disconnect, call /v1/chat/stream/resume with the token + offset. Example: see attached redwood_sdk_streaming_snippets.md.

3) Tool calling schema (inventory lookup) — minimal example: 
- function name: inventory_lookup
- inputs: { sku: string, location: string }
- output: { available: boolean, qty: number, eta_days: number }
- Redwood will include the function signature in the chat response. You can stub the endpoint to return a JSON object matching the schema for the pilot.

4) API routes & headers
- Rerank: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
  headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>, Content-Type: application/json
- Chat streaming: wss://stream.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream?model=redwood-5b
  headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>

5) Observability
- We'll provision a trial project in Redwood Console with per-request traces and cost per token breakdown. You can add team viewers.

I'll follow up with the sample JSONL, the node streaming snippet, and a minimal curl example for the rerank route. If you prefer Python examples instead, tell me and Dev will author them this week.

—Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
